notes.title: Casinopia Server Closing Notice
notes.notes:
Hi all,

First, we would like to thank everyone who has supported Casinopia up until now. With all your supports we tried our best to provide satisfactory services. However despite our efforts, the game just is not sustainable anymore. With heavy hearts, we have to announce that we are going to close the servers of Casinopia: The Blackjack. 

Please refer to the schedule below for service termination:

[Closing Schedule]
▶ Closing Date: 2018.09.30 00:00 KST (GMT +9)

Thank you again for all of your love and supports! ːsteamsadː

notes.title: Casinopia: The Blackjack is Now Available on Oculus Rift
notes.notes:
Greeting everyone,

We hope you have a great day!

Today we are having a new update. In this update, we made Casinopia: The Blackjack available for Oculus Rift owners. 

Even though some of you are already able to play the game using Oculus Rift, we want to make your that you get the best experience when playing our game so we officially release game for Oculus Rift as well.

Now, all of Oculus Rift owner who were unable to experience and enjoy Casinopia: The Blackjack before, can now play the game and join with other players!

Thank you!

notes.title: Casinopia: The Blackjack is now available!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We are happy to announce that Casinopia: The Blackjack is now available on HTC VIVE!!

ENJOY THE GAME! :)

notes.title: Controllers Manual Instruction
notes.notes:
Please refer to the information below for the controllers instruction manual:

1. [b]Application Menu Button[/b]: Game Menu

2. [b]Trigger Button[/b]: By pressing trigger button you may pick chips to bet, hold down the trigger to grab chips. You can also choose the amount of money to bet by using touchpad.

3. [b]Touchpad[/b]: Use touchpad to walk around when you are a spectator. Also you can use Right-Left touchpad to choose the amount of money for betting and to choose action while playing the game such as HIT, STAND, DOUBLE DOWN, and SURRENDER. (check image below)
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30760176/ebe96866c84581aae9628f58e8ee9e7991081b20.png[/img]

4. [b]Motion Controller[/b]: activate motion controller by moving the controller up-down(HIT) or right-left(STAND). There will be 2 labels on the table, HIT and STAND. Please be aware that those labels are not buttons, moving your controllers towards those labels might cause unwanted motion control. [i](e.g. when a player tries to click HIT label with right hands, the game might take it as right-left motion which is STAND)[/i] 


ENJOY!!

notes.title: The latest version of graphics card is needed to play the game!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

If you encounter issues during the game, please update your graphics card to the latest version. 

Please follow the step below to update your graphics card:

1. Open [url=https://www.geforce.com/drivers] NVIDIA Website[/url].
2. Click [b]‘Start Search’[/b] on Manual Driver Search section.
3. The result will come up and click the latest version (check the latest release 4. date), and you will go to another page.
5. Click [b]‘Agree & Download’[/b].
6. Install the file after completing the download.
7. Enjoy the game!! ^^

(see the image below for details)

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30760176/2eed88c1f87576e8ed399e05a63f75a60b2b1fde.png[/img]
